description: This file defines the ConfigurableLanguage entity class for Drupal, including its properties, methods, and entity type annotations. It manages language configuration, including creation, deletion, and property management within the Drupal multilingual system.

classes.name: ConfigurableLanguage
classes.description: Represents a configurable language entity in Drupal, managing language properties, lifecycle events, and integration with Drupal's multilingual system.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if this language is the default language.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Determines if the language is locked from editing.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook to store multilingual state before saving.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Post-save hook to update language settings and rebuild services.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Pre-delete hook to prevent deletion of the default language.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Post-delete hook to update language weights and clean up configuration.

methods.name: getDefaultLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the current default language code.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the human-readable name of the language.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the language.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the text direction of the language.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight used for ordering languages.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for the language.

methods.name: createFromLangcode
methods.description: Creates a ConfigurableLanguage object from a language code, filling in details if known.
